name: Continuwuity
short_desc: Community-maintained Matrix homeserver written in Rust (successor to Conduit)
author: Continuwuity
description: Continuwuity is a fast, lightweight Matrix homeserver — the community-driven continuation of conduwuit/Conduit. Single Rust binary with an embedded RocksDB database. NOTE: this is a homeserver only (no web UI); connect with any Matrix client such as Element or Cinny, pointing it at your domain. The first registered user becomes the server admin. The server name (your domain) is permanent and cannot be changed without wiping the database.
